Music / Live music

Get there for the opening act

Your next favourite sound might be on stage early.

✳
The Offbeat EditCulture Issue · 1 min read

IN THIS STORY

Arrive without expectationsGive a new sound some timeFollow the discoveryMore from Music

Arrive without expectations

An opening set is an invitation to arrive without expectations. You may not know the words, but that can make listening more attentive.

Give a new sound some time

Find a comfortable spot, give the artist a full song before deciding, and note a track name if something stays with you. Discovery does not have to happen on a feed.

Follow the discovery

If you enjoy the set, look for the artist’s official releases afterwards. A little curiosity can turn an early arrival into the highlight of the night.

“Your next favourite sound might be on stage early.”
